# Implementation plan — issue #4713

Planning ref: `main` at `66707437b53aa54446d661c8f409795577d13ead`. No Integration branch is specified; no mismatch is established. The clarification phase found no questions, and `/answer [auto-answered-by-clarify]` supplies no additional requirements. The historical `Q1: B` answer concerns merging an earlier Claude phase PR, not this implementation.

Scope-mode: Hold Scope  
Reuse-audit: extends `.github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml`  
Scope-mode justification: Extend the existing 30-minute sweep rather than add a workflow or manual operation. Include both requested conclusions and their safety checks, rather than a cancelled-only shortcut. Where the incremental completeness cost is small, this follows `unattended_system_instructions.md` §6: Security > Correctness & safety > Backward compatibility > Operational clarity > Performance > Speed.

## Automation and wiring

Use the **30-minute `sweep` job**. It already enumerates open, non-draft PRs; the hourly `claude-pr-catch-all` is scoped to Claude fixes. Invoke the helper from that job on its existing schedule, and honor its `dry_run` and `head_ref_filter` inputs. Limit this feature to coding-workflows: `.github/workflows/ci.yml` is identified here, but no consumer CI filename is established. No long-running supervisor, database gate, or future-removal registry entry is needed; the helper runs only within the scheduled job.

## Files likely to change

- `.github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml` — add head SHA to the existing PR snapshot, persist that snapshot for the helper, and add a trusted-default-branch helper step.
- `scripts/ci_cancelled_rerun.py` — implement the scheduled decision and re-run operation.
- `tests/test_ci_cancelled_rerun.py` and `.github/workflows/ci.yml` — cover decisions and wire the tests into an existing CI job.
- `agents.md`, `README.md`, `docs/INVENTORY.md`, `changelog.d/4713-ci-cancelled-rerun.md` — register the prefix and helper, document the switch and behavior, and record the change.

## Functions or modules to implement

Reuse the sweep’s PR listing; make **no second PR enumeration**. The helper should validate PR numbers and SHAs, apply the sweep’s filter, dry-run, and `[skip ai]` conventions, and examine CI runs only for current snapshot heads. For each PR, select the newest attributable CI run. Re-run it only if it is completed with `cancelled` or `startup_failure`, has integer `run_attempt == 1`, and no CI run for that head is active. Skip `failure`, other conclusions, malformed or unattributable runs, and superseded heads. Deduplicate a shared head within the tick.

Document the batching contract in the helper docstring: **one** repository-wide `ci.yml` listing with `status=completed&per_page=100`; fixed-count repository-wide listings for active statuses, since the completed listing cannot prove inactivity; and no CI run-list read per PR. Use the existing snapshot locally. Document why the sweep’s *review*-run cache cannot answer a *CI*-run query. Treat failed, malformed, or capacity-truncated listings as insufficient evidence and make no POST. GitHub supports filtering workflow-run listings by workflow filename and status; `per_page` is capped at 100. ([docs.github.com](https://docs.github.com/en/rest/actions/workflow-runs?apiVersion=2026-03-10))

For an eligible run, call only `POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/runs/{run_id}/rerun-failed-jobs`. GitHub specifies that this re-runs failed jobs and their dependent jobs, requires Actions write permission, and returns HTTP `201` on success. Log a refusal—including one for a `startup_failure` with no restartable failed job—as a skip; **do not** fall back to a full-workflow re-run or automatically retry an uncertain POST. Emit one `CI_CANCELLED_RERUN pr=<n> head=<sha> run=<id> action=<rerun|skip> reason=<…>` line per examined PR. ([docs.github.com](https://docs.github.com/en/rest/actions/workflow-runs?apiVersion=2026-03-10))

## Data structures affected

Add `head_sha` to the sweep’s ephemeral PR snapshot. Build local completed-run and active-head indexes from the repository-wide responses. No persistent pipeline-state schema changes are planned. Add `CI_CANCELLED_RERUN` to both stable-prefix lists in `agents.md`.

## API/interface changes

Add repo variable `CI_CANCELLED_AUTO_RERUN_ENABLED`, default `true` **in the helper itself** as well as workflow wiring; disabling it makes no CI API calls or POSTs. Keep existing dispatch inputs unchanged. The sweep declares `actions: write`; use a token with effective Actions write permission for the POST. ([docs.github.com](https://docs.github.com/en/rest/actions/workflow-runs?apiVersion=2026-03-10))

## Decisions

### D1 — Use the general sweep
- **Chosen:** Extend the 30-minute `sweep` job.
- **Alternatives considered:** The hourly `claude-pr-catch-all` job.
- **Why:** Recovery applies to open non-draft PRs generally, and `sweep` already has their enumeration.

### D2 — Re-run failed jobs only
- **Chosen:** Leave a refused `rerun-failed-jobs` request untouched and log it.
- **Alternatives considered:** An earlier progress comment proposed a full-rerun fallback for `startup_failure`.
- **Why:** A full rerun conflicts with the issue’s specified operation and can re-execute successful jobs.

### D3 — Restrict workflow identification to this repo
- **Chosen:** Enable the helper only for coding-workflows’ identified `ci.yml`.
- **Alternatives considered:** Guessing a consumer CI workflow filename.
- **Why:** The issue permits a source-repo-only implementation when consumer CI cannot be identified.

## Security considerations

The trust boundary is author-controlled PR metadata leading to an Actions write. Validate the snapshot and numeric run ID; require the CI workflow, PR-run attribution, current head, conclusion, attempt, and inactive-head evidence before POST. Do not execute a PR-head helper: check out the trusted default-branch script with credentials not persisted. Do not log credentials or raw API error bodies. Abuse cases include a forged snapshot ID, a stale head, ambiguous PR attribution, and an active re-run hidden by an incomplete listing. No new public endpoint or money-handling surface is introduced. GitHub’s `pull_request` workflow executes against a merge branch by default, so do not equate its in-job `GITHUB_SHA` with the PR’s head SHA; require a validated association before acting. ([docs.github.com](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/workflows-and-actions/events-that-trigger-workflows))

## Risks and edge cases

- `run_attempt` is per **run ID**, not a durable counter per head. Reject a visible prior attempt greater than one on the same head, but document that a bounded listing cannot prove an absolute once-per-head limit across distinct, older run IDs.
- A push after the PR snapshot can race the POST. Current-head matching prevents re-running an already-superseded run *at snapshot time*; the specified batched-read budget supplies no atomic head-bound POST.
- A `startup_failure` may have no failed jobs for the endpoint to restart. Refusal is observable and does not authorize a full rerun.
- Historical Claude comments describe a separate project branch and an earlier implementation. They do not change this planning ref or establish that its files exist on `main`.

## Testing considerations

Mock repository-wide listings and POSTs for cancelled attempt 1, attempt 2, `failure`, `startup_failure`, superseded head, active run, and switch off. Cover newer success on the same head, multiple PRs or runs sharing a head, malformed and truncated responses, `[skip ai]`, filter, dry-run, API refusal, and no full-rerun fallback. Assert fixed-count list calls, no per-PR CI reads, trusted checkout, and Actions permission wiring. Run focused and existing sweep contract tests, workflow lint, and the size guard; measure the edited YAML with `wc -c` and move an inline body into `scripts/` if it reaches 480,000 bytes.

PLAN_SELF_CHECK: WARNING: `run_attempt` and a 100-run listing cannot establish an absolute once-per-head guarantee across distinct historical run IDs; the implementation must fail closed on insufficient evidence and document this limit.
